card_summary: Lower mountains (~30%) and dry out the climate: less sea-surface humidity and less evaporation. Modest, seed-dependent changes; regenerate to see them.

events.transcript_tail:
Choose what to do, type a request, and press Send. The reply is shown here; nothing is saved until you press Save to note.
You
Make the climate drier and the mountains lower.
Looked up 8 matching actions first (about 502 tokens).
The model is reading the climate, weather, world settings…
MODEL PROPOSAL
“Lower mountains (~30%) and dry out the climate: less sea-surface humidity and less evaporation. Modest, seed-dependent changes; regenerate to see them.”
Peak altitude  (peak_m)   4000 m  ->  2800 m   -30%
    “Lower the mountains: peak altitude down ~30% (4000 → 2800 m), scaling all heights lower.”  (model's words)
Sea-surface humidity  (climate.ocean_hum)   1.00  ->  0.75   -25%
    “Drier sea air (~25% less) for a drier world overall.”  (model's words)
Evaporation  (climate.evap)   0.12  ->  0.09   -25%
    “Less moisture picked up over the sea (0.12 → 0.09), a drier world.”  (model's words)
3 settings refresh the climate with Recompute in the status bar.
Applying changes the settings, then refreshes the climate. The world itself is not replaced.
[Dismiss]
[Apply and regenerate]
